w.name: SERIUS
w.lore: SERIUS learned to stitch their own wounds with horsehair and rusty needles, realizing that a life in the shadows is merely a slow death.
w.origin: Found half-starved clutching a rusted nail in the Cinder Wards

injuries.name: Broken Arm
injuries.description: Arm in a sling. Fighting ability devastated.

w.name: CORNELIUS
w.lore: CORNELIUS learned to anticipate an ambush by the sudden silence of the alley rats, until they watched the arena gates close behind them, finally feeling safe.
w.origin: Abandoned in the pitch-black oubliettes of the Silent Keep

w.name: SYRAH
w.lore: SYRAH practiced throwing rusted spoons with lethal accuracy, until they broke their first rusted iron collar, vowing that their next chains would be made of gold.
w.origin: Survived the Blood Rot by hiding beneath the corpses of the fallen

w.name: ECHO
w.lore: ECHO would purposefully numb their own limbs in ice-water to learn to fight without feeling pain, until a brutal betrayal taught them that trusting anyone is a fatal flaw in the blood sports.
w.origin: Found shivering in a burnt-out alchemist

w.name: VYN
w.lore: VYN learned to predict strikes by watching the shadows of passing guards, until a vicious beating by the city watch forged their resolve into an unbreakable, jagged spike.
w.origin: Raised in the ash-choked chimneys of the Upper Spire

w.name: ZUNOGHAK
w.lore: ZUNOGHAK developed a terrifying stillness before engaging in brawls, waiting for the moment the iron portcullis of the arena would rise on their true destiny.
w.origin: Survived the great fire of the Ash Dunes by burying themselves in the cool, blood-soaked sand

w.name: SAEDON
w.lore: SAEDON would smile while bleeding, as if pain meant nothing, knowing that the iron portcullis of the arena was the only true gate to freedom.
w.origin: Found shivering amongst the bones in the Kingswood Ossuary

w.name: THAZAEX
w.lore: THAZAEX could perfectly mimic the screams of dying men, ready to carve their name into the annals of history with steel.
w.origin: Sold by starving parents to the cruel skin-merchants of the Pale Wards

injuries.name: Broken Arm

w.name: SENEPUICUS
w.lore: SENEPUICUS was known for an unnerving stillness before striking a blow, now hunting the very men who slaughtered their kin.
